project.name: Brightpath Academy
project.description: Self-paced online course platform where instructors publish courses and learners complete lessons, quizzes, and reviews.

looks.reason: Calm, studious, and airy with ample whitespace and rounded components fitting self-paced education.
Refined flat design emphasizing quiet reading, clarity, and deep teal focus.
Structured informational clarity and high readability across curriculums and categories.

requested.words: calm and studious, plenty of white space, a deep teal accent

design.reason: Brightpath Academy is a calm self-paced learning platform where learners browse courses and progress through lessons, while instructors and admins manage curriculums.

tours.name: Learn and Complete Course
tours.outcome: Learner finishes all lessons and completes the course.

steps.title: Browse catalogue by category. Rule: Only published courses are visible
Enroll in course (the enrollment becomes active). Rule: Learner must not already be enrolled
Resume and view next lesson (the lesson becomes in_progress). Rule: Must follow lesson order
Mark lesson complete (the lesson_progress becomes completed). Rule: All previous lessons must be completed
Complete course (the enrollment becomes completed). Rule: All lessons in the course must be marked complete

tours.name: Publish Course
tours.outcome: A structured course is published and available for learner enrollment.

steps.title: Create category (the category becomes active). Rule: Category name must be unique
Create course draft (the course becomes draft). Rule: Must select an existing category
Add ordered lessons and quizzes (the lesson becomes draft). Rule: Lessons must have video or written content and sequential order
Publish course (the course becomes published). Rule: Course must contain at least one lesson

tours.name: Review Course
tours.outcome: Learner review and rating are published for the completed course.

steps.title: Submit course rating and review (the review becomes published). Rule: Learner must have completed the course and can only review once
